title: Thread Border Router Parent Churn
app: Home Assistant, Matter and Thread border routers, Alexa routine logs, Google Home automations, Zigbee2MQTT bridges, SmartThings, Node-RED, and webhooks streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thread:router
| bin _time span=1d
| stats dc(parent_id) as parent_count by endpoint _time
| where parent_count>2
| sort - parent_count
description: Uses Thread mesh telemetry telemetry to monitor how many different parents each endpoint used each day in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for endpoints wandering too much around the mesh, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Thread mesh telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Daily table of parent-count churn by endpoint.
grandmaExplanation: It records how many different parents each endpoint used each day so you can spot endpoints wandering too much around the mesh before it becomes annoying.
